blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The University of the Philippines Gawad Plaridel and the UP College of Media and Communication (CMC) mourned the death of Eugenia Duran-Apostol, Philippine Daily Inquirer co-founder and first recipient of the award, saying her “legacy endures in every journalist.” In 2004, Apostol became the inaugural recipient of the UP Gawad Plaridel Award, the highest honor the UP CMC bestows on outstanding media practitioners. “Eugenia Apostol’s passing marks the end of an era, but her legacy endures in every journalist who continues to defend truth, independence, and the people’s right to know,” said the UP Gawad Plaridel and UP CMC in […]...
